If you have trouble starting UNICASE (server or client), you get an unexpected exception or similiar, it is best practice to bring your development environment to a well-defined state. Situations in which this might be neccessary include:

    * changes to the UNICASE model, emfstore model or workspace model
    * a server crash where the database was rolled back
    * a client crash where the workspace was demaged


Follow this procedure to fix your development environment

   # Stop the UNICASE client or server if still running
   # Update all plugins to the latest revision in the svn repository
   # Check if you have obsolete plugins or missing plugins in your workspace (use svn repo browser to get a list of plugins)
   # Delete the eclipse runtime workspace
         * Go to your default workspace location
         * Delete the folder named runtime-EclipseApplication
   # Delete the UNICASE workspace: Delete the folder ~/.unicase.dev/workspace
   # Restart Eclipse
